scope: Theorem 11.6 (Guarded cylinders in a torus chart) of the manuscript “Incompressible Box Transport and Finite Computation” (preprints/Incompressible-Box-Transport-and-Finite-Computation-October-6-2026/manuscript.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 376 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 2505dc09d3f2c24b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On the unit torus, the fixed label (1/8, 0, 0) and the strip {x : x1 (mod 1) ∈ (−1/4, 0)} realize halting by a general mean-zero force with zero initial velocity and pressure. It is periodic after time one and all its mixed derivatives are bounded. The torus comparison class gives uniqueness.
